facts.function: senses engine speed and positions the fuel/throttle valve to maintain a set speed (engine governing)
facts.form: integrated valve actuator with built-in control electronics; separate speed controllers

gri_path: GRI 1: first-named article (integrated valve actuator) classified; chapter 90 note 7(b) covers automatic regulators of non-electrical quantities (engine speed) that measure the actual value and bring it to and maintain it at a set value
Section XVI note 1(m) excludes chapter 90 articles, so 8501 (motor) and 8537 (control panels) and 8481 (valves) yield to heading 9032 for a self-contained regulating unit
GRI 6: 9032.89 other instruments, 9032.89.60 other, statistical suffix .85 other (not a hydraulic/pneumatic or complete climate system line)

rejected_alternatives.reason: K89109 placed a stand-alone DC-motor actuator with no control function here; an integrated actuator containing its own speed control acts as a regulator of heading 9032
engine speed controllers that measure and maintain speed are automatic regulators under chapter 90 note 7; Section XVI note 1(m) excludes chapter 90 goods
the article is not merely a valve; its function is automatic regulation of engine speed

missing_facts: Does the integrated valve actuator contain its own closed-loop speed/position control electronics, or is it only a motor-driven actuator receiving a command signal (which would point to 8501)?
classify separately: APECS 500 Single Speed Electronic Engine Controller and APECS digital controllers (likely also 9032.89.60.85)
classification.rationale: The description names several articles; the first-named integrated valve actuator is classified. An engine speed governing device that compares actual speed to a set point and moves the fuel valve to correct it is an automatic regulator within chapter 90 note 7, and NY K89109 (in force) classified Woodward electrically powered governor controllers and complete governor systems in 9032.89.6085. If the actuator is only a motor with no control function, K89109 shows it would fall in 8501.31, so the decisive fact is listed as missing.
